description: Na₂U(WO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.94 Å. U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent W sites. In the first W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-35°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.24 Å. In the second W site, W is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing WO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-35°. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.25 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one U and two W atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two W atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent W atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent U, and one W atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONaU₂W trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent U, and one W atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom.
